name: kyte
description: Your company's kyte workspace in Claude: customers, contacts, deals, projects, hours, invoices, goals, people and documents — read and changed as you, with your permissions.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Claude may read the workspace but not create, change or delete anything.

data_folder.title: Data folder
data_folder.description: Where this connection keeps its copy of the workspace — its own folder, so Claude never competes with a kyte session in a terminal. Sign in for it once: kyte login --db <this folder>.

kyte_path.title: kyte program (optional)
kyte_path.description: Only if kyte is installed somewhere unusual. Left empty, the plugin finds it where the kyte installer puts it.
